basis: Ranges are our judgment inside the sourced market ranges for a first-year solo designer. One-page sites: GoDaddy $500 to $5,000, its own service from $499. Small sites: Wix $500 to $10,000, Squarespace $500 to a couple thousand. Care plans: GoWP $39 to $99, WP Buffs $89 to $359 a month.

packages.label: One-page website
includes: Phone-first one-page site in your colors
Tap-to-call button, hours, services and area
Google basics: title, description, business details for search
Set up on your own domain and hosting account

packages.label: Small business website (up to 5 pages)
includes: Up to 5 pages (home, services, about, gallery, contact)
Booking or quote request set up
Google Business Profile website link updated

packages.label: Fix list on your current site
includes: The top 5 fixes from the site check, done on your current builder
Phone check on a real phone

addons.label: Online booking or ordering set up
Business email on your domain set up (you pay Google)

care_plans.label: Care plan
includes: Updates, backups and an uptime check
1 small edit a month (hours, prices, a photo)

care_plans.label: Care plan plus
includes: Up to 5 small edits a month
A Google profile post each week
